verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitHub grants granular permission sets to fine-grained personal access tokens, and a community report confirms protected branches as a branch-level control on paid plans. Nothing in the pack documents assigning roles or permissions to users or teams at the organization, project, repository, or environment level. missing for 10: org/team role assignment docs, project-level permissions, repository role permissions, environment protection rules, first-party branch protection docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can assign granular permissions at organization, project, repository, branch, and environment level

citations.quote: When you create a fine-grained personal access token, you grant it a set of permissions. Permissions define what resources the token can access via the API.
User lists what you lose downgrading from Team to Free on private repos: protected branches
